verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state Devin can be asked to tackle Linear/Jira tickets directly, and can be tagged from Slack/Teams threads discussing a bug, showing task assignment from existing tickets/issues into an agent session; API also supports programmatic session creation which could integrate with issue trackers. Missing for 10: no direct evidence of a native GitHub Issues integration or a documented one-click 'assign to Devin' button from within an issue tracker UI, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific workflow succeeding.
